notes: args/result are DSL types. kind=read ops may be used in `data` declarations and `call`; kind=write ops only in `call` and require an idempotencyKey. Every op here must have a Go handler registered in backend/internal/ops (the server refuses to start otherwise).

demo.profile.result: {name: string, tickets: number, avatar: string, level: number, authorized: bool}

demo.offers.result: list<{id: string, title: string, subtitle: string, price: number, image: string, until: number}>

demo.plans.result: list<{id: string, title: string, monthly: number, perks: list<string>}>

demo.subscribe.args: {email: string, name: string, plan: string, promo: string}

raffle.overview.result: {tickets: number, place: number?, participants: number, hidden: bool, startsAt: number?, endsAt: number?, daily: {streakDay: number, claimedToday: bool, claimAmount: number?, days: list<{day: number, amount: number, state: "claimed" | "available" | "waiting"}>}, mainPrize: {title: string, image: string?}?, prizes: list<{rank: number, title: string, tickets: number, image: string?}>, tasks: list<{id: string, name: string, description: string, icon: string?, tickets: number, cooldownUntil: number?, progress: list<{label: string, value: string, ticket: bool}>}>, rules: list<{name: string, description: string, icon: string?, tickets: number}>, tasksDone: number, tasksTotal: number, share: string?}

raffle.promo.result: {active: bool, endsAt: number?, place: number?, tasksDone: number, tasksTotal: number}

raffle.leaderboard.result: {total: number, myPosition: number?, items: list<{key: string, position: number, name: string, tickets: number, isMe: bool}>}

raffle.tickets.result: {total: number, items: list<{id: string, createdAt: number}>}

raffle.invites.result: {total: number, maxTicketsPerInvite: number, items: list<{key: string, name: string, tickets: number}>}
